explanation: Changing `InputLayer(input_shape=(1,))` to `InputLayer(input_shape=())` with a `Flatten()` layer reflects the broader refactor that removes the automatic `tf.expand_dims` in the predictor, but if any code path still passes a 1D tensor without going through `Flatten` (e.g., direct model calls outside the trainer), the Dense layer will receive a scalar-per-sample input instead of a (batch, 1) tensor, causing shape mismatches.
